  "pros": [
    "Robust data modeling with LookML ensures data consistency and governance.",
    "Empowers business users and customers with self-service data exploration capabilities.",
    "Significant improvement in flexibility and user experience compared to Oracle Business Intelligence."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial learning curve for the LookML modeling language can be steep for new team members.",
    "Cost can be a consideration, particularly as usage scales.",
    "Customer support, while generally helpful, might sometimes be slower than desired."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Head of Data likely found Looker to be a powerful and transformative tool for managing data insights. Its strong data modeling capabilities and ability to provide self-service access to business users were key advantages over previous solutions like Oracle BI. While the initial learning curve and cost were minor challenges, the platform's overall functionality and impact on data governance led to a highly positive experience."
